slot_cy = 24.0      # slot centre Y (from -Y face)
slot_cz = 17.0      # slot centre Z
slot_ang = 45.0     # angle from horizontal

    length, channel_w, channel_d
)

    length / 2 - notch_w / 2, 0, height - channel_d / 2
